subject: EdgeCraft remittance & billing contact handoff after acquisition
messages:
From: Sofia Alvarez <sofia.alvarez@edgecraft.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: finance@edgecraft.com
Date: 2027-05-30T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Billing remittance & new AP contact after Helios acquisition

Hi Logan,

Hope you’re well — following our acquisition by Helios Systems, our AP team is consolidating payout flows and will be changing remittance addresses and the remit-to legal entity for invoices. Can you confirm the steps we need to take to ensure future invoices go to:  

  Helios Systems Inc.
  AP Operations
  remits@helios-pay.com
  Tax ID: 12-3456789

We expect the change to be effective 2027-06-15. We also have a signed purchase addendum to update the billing entity for outstanding invoices — I’ve attached the draft remittance PDF and will follow up with a signed copy.

What do you need from our side (POs, signed addendum, updated W-9/resident tax docs)? Also: will updating the remittance affect current open invoices or only future billing periods?

Thanks,
Sofia Alvarez
Head of Finance, EdgeCraft
sofia.alvarez@edgecraft.com
+1 415 555 0198

Attachment: EdgeCraft_Remittance_Instructions_2027.pdf (PDF, 78KB)

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Alvarez <sofia.alvarez@edgecraft.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-30T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Billing remittance & new AP contact after Helios acquisition

Hi Sofia — congrats on the close, and thanks for the heads-up. Short answer: we can repoint future invoices and update the legal remit entity, but we’ll need a couple of things to make the change clean:  

1) Signed billing addendum or amendment that authorizes Redwood to invoice Helios Systems (we can accept DocuSign).
2) Updated remit-to email and tax registration (W-9 for U.S. entities).
3) For any outstanding invoices issued to EdgeCraft, can you confirm whether they should be reissued to Helios or paid by EdgeCraft and followed up separately? If you want us to reissue, mark which invoices and we’ll re-generate with new remit.

I’ll loop in Marissa (account lead) to coordinate reissuance and collections, and Evelyn from Legal for the addendum review. Once we have the signed addendum and W-9 we’ll:  

- Create a billing profile for Helios in our system.
- Reissue any specified outstanding invoices with the new remit-to and tax info.
- Update our accounting vendor record and payment routing (we push invoice PDF via email + optional AR portal link).

If it helps, we can target a staggered cutover: reissue past-due/open invoices this week, and set new billing for invoices dated on/after 2027-06-15.

Best,
Logan Wright
Revenue Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.ai
+1 650 555 2210

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Sofia Alvarez <sofia.alvarez@edgecraft.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-31T09:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Billing remittance & new AP contact after Helios acquisition

Thanks, Logan + Sofia — I can take lead on the invoice reissuance and short collection items. Quick plan:  

- Please confirm the list of outstanding invoice numbers to be reissued (EdgeCraft invoices dated through 2027-05). If you prefer, we can reissue all open ones and apply the same payment terms.
- I’ll prepare a small amendment template for signature (Evelyn — can you confirm if Redwood needs language about legacy liabilities / effective date?).
- Monica from Payments ops will update vendor banking metadata (we use Stripe Connect for some workflows) — Monica, will follow up with the internal change ticket.

Sofia — can you send the signed addendum (DocuSign link is fine) and the W-9 for Helios? Also include the AP contact name and person who will approve payments going forward. If EdgeCraft wants to funnel prior invoices through Helios, note any internal PO or cost-center mapping we should apply.

Thanks — will aim to have reissued PDFs and a payment portal link ready once we have signed docs.

—Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Attachment: (none)

From: Carlos Medina <c.medina@acquirer.co>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Sofia Alvarez <sofia.alvarez@edgecraft.com>
Cc: finance@edgecraft.com
Date: 2027-06-01T11:24:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Billing remittance & new AP contact after Helios acquisition

Hi team — copying in Helios AP to confirm: Helios would like to take over remittance for invoices dated 2027-06-15 onward. For five open invoices (EC-20270501, EC-20270510, EC-20270518, EC-20270602, EC-20270608) they want the legacy EdgeCraft invoices reissued to Helios so they can include them on a single monthly payment run. We will provide the DocuSign-signed addendum and the W-9 by EOD 2027-06-02.

I expect the signed DocuSign envelope id will be: DSE-9876543210.

Carlos Medina
VP Finance, Helios Systems (on behalf of EdgeCraft)
c.medina@acquirer.co

Attachment: Signed_Billing_Addendum-EC-ACQ.pdf (PDF, 120KB)

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Alvarez <sofia.alvarez@edgecraft.com>, Carlos Medina <c.medina@acquirer.co>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, finance@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-06-02T16:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Billing remittance & new AP contact after Helios acquisition

Appreciate the quick turnaround, team — we received the signed addendum and have the W-9 on file (thanks, Carlos). Next steps from Redwood:  

1) Marissa will reissue the five invoice PDFs to:  
   Helios Systems Inc.
   remits@helios-pay.com
   Tax ID: 12-3456789

2) Monica will create vendor record and update payment routing (Stripe/ACH metadata) & tag the account as "hel-ec-acq" in the ledger.
3) Finance ops will push reissued invoices to Helios AP portal and send email copies to remits@helios-pay.com.
4) Any payments already processed to EdgeCraft will be reconciled by Helios; for unapplied payments, we’ll hold credit memos until you confirm allocation.

We’ll include a short note on each reissued invoice that references the original invoice number (Original: EC-20270501) to preserve audit trail. Expect the reissued PDFs in your inbox by tomorrow morning (2027-06-03).

If you anticipate an early payment run and want us to expedite, tell us which invoice numbers and we’ll prioritize.

Best regards,
Logan Wright
Revenue Operations Manager | Redwood Inference

Attachment: reissue-instructions.txt (internal stub)
